meta.data: NYC TLC Yellow Taxi trips (real daily files)
meta.note: Faults are injected into real days; every window is used once for a faulty case and once for a clean case. 'Clean' means no fault was injected, not that the day is free of real anomalies. 'Ordinary' clean days exclude documented events (federal holidays and the Jan 25-26 2026 NYC winter storm). The scripted baselines see less information than the full agent; they are not LLM calls.
